subject: english
question: What is the ANTONYM of the word ‘perfect’, as used in the passage?
solution:
The correct answer is Option 3 i.e. **"Unsatisfactory".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Perfect**: (उत्तम) - Having all the required or desirable elements, qualities, or characteristics; as good as it is possible to be.

 
 
• **Example**: She strived to achieve a perfect score on her exam.
 
 
 
• **Unsatisfactory**: (असंतोषजनक) - Not satisfactory; not good enough.
 
 
• **Example**: The project was delayed due to unsatisfactory work by the contractor.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is "Option 3".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Troublesome**: (कष्टप्रद) - Causing difficulty or annoyance. 
 
• **Limited**: (सीमित) - Restricted in size, amount, or extent; few, small, or short.
 
• **Laughable**: (हास्यास्पद) - So ludicrous as to be amusing.
